real_interview.content: IntroV4Confirmation (hi i'm ellie thanks for coming in today i was created to talk to people in a safe and secure environment i'm not a therapist but i'm here to learn about people and would love to learn about you i'll ask a few questions to get us started and please feel free to tell me anything your answers are totally confidential are you ok with this)
how_doingV (so how are you doing today)
like_about_LA (what are some things you really like about l_a)
i like the weather i like the people
dont_like_LA (what are some things you don't really like about l_a)
i don't like the traffic uh that's primarily it
study (what did you study at school)
hard_decision (how did you decide to do that)
uh it's a topic that just really interested me the most out of all the other subjects
still_working_on_X (are you still working in that)
tell_about_that (can you tell me about that)
i like being able to write what i want to write uh right now i write things that i'm not really that interested in
todays_kids (what do you think of today's kids)
i think they have it pretty easy they don't know how easy they have it <laughter>
travel_shoes (i'm sure you can tell by my shoes i'm not much of a world explorer do you travel a lot)
shyoutgoing (do you consider yourself more shy or outgoing)
mm depends on the situation or who i'm around when i first meet people i can be shy uh but if it's someone i've known for a while i can be outgoing
relax_fishtank (sometimes when i'm feeling tense i turn on the fish tank screensaver hey i know it's not hawaii but it's the best i've got what do you do to relax)
um i'll lay down or try some sort like deep breathing
or uh just maybe do something that's kinda fun and mind numbing like watch t_v
control_temper (how are you at controlling your temper)
i'm pretty good i don't really let anger show that much um
i'm not like a i don't have a fiery temper or anything like that i'm pretty rational
last_argument (when was the last time you argued with someone and what was it about)
i actually can't remember when the last time i argued with someone was 'cause it's been so long
feelguilty (what's something you feel guilty about)
i guess i feel guilty about the fact that i don't talk to my grandparents as much as i should
family_relationship (tell me about your relationship with your family)
um i'm close with my grandparents but not really anyone else in my family
uh 'cause they basically sort of raised me uh and uh my parents
really in the picture that much
situation_handled (tell me about a situation that you wish you had handled differently)
i can't really think of one
memory_erase (tell me about an event or something that you wish you could erase from your memory)
i guess uh when my sister died it was really traumatizing
uncomfortable_talkV (is it uncomfortable for you to talk about this)
hard_decisionB (tell me about the hardest decision you've ever had to make)
i guess the hardest decision i've ever had to make is deciding whether or not to divorce my husband
change_directions (what made you decide to do that)
uh because we weren't getting along and there was no reason to stay married but i still felt like i should stick it out
i mean it was hard at the time uh but
i made the right decision i think
influence_positive (who's someone that's been a positive influence in your life)
uh my grandmother was a positive influence from a young age
tell_about_that (can you tell me about that)
um she's just a very strong powerful
and that rubbed off on me
easy_sleep (how easy is it for you to get a good night's sleep)
uh not really super easy um
i sort of i mean it's my probably my fault i go to bed too late
sleep_affects (what are you like when you don't sleep well)
just sort of foggy and distracted
feel_lately (how have you been feeling lately)
behavior_changes (have you noticed any changes in your behavior or thoughts lately)
it's been the same as ever
ptsd_diagnosed (have you ever been diagnosed with p_t_s_d)
depression_diagnosed (have you been diagnosed with depression)
happy_lasttime (tell me about the last time you felt really happy)
last night i was just hanging out with my friends and was just having like a really good time sharing stories and laughing and stuff
BF_describe (how would your best friend describe you)
uh probably funny and uh easy to get along with but also caring
ideal_weekendC (tell me how you spend your ideal weekend)
uh i spend my ideal weekend not really doing much like maybe just sitting around and reading or going to the movies watching t_v
there's not i don't <do> i don't think uh i think regretting <r> regretting things is a waste of time
advice_back (what advice would you give to yourself ten or twenty years ago)
don't go out of your way to try and impress people
they like you then they like you
self_change (what are some things you wish you could change about yourself)
sometimes i can be kinda lazy
i'd like to have more of a um like sort of  uh
give_example (can you give me an example of that)
uh just sort of putting off stuff um until you know right when it's due or after it's due things like that um  procrastinating
feelbadly (tell me about a time when someone made you feel really badly about yourself)
sometimes for the things that i write uh people will write negative things about me like in the comment section on a website
and that'll make me feel bad
Ellie17Dec2012_07 (what would you say are some of your best qualities)
and funny and a good friend
Ellie17Dec2012_08 (what are you most proud of in your life)
i guess i'm most proud of the fact that uh
and my friends and my status in the world
i'm proud of the fact that i feel comfortable with it
Ellie17Dec2012_09 (what are some things that usually put you in a good mood)
um just hanging out with my friends uh
asked_everything (okay i think i have asked everything i need to)
appreciate_open (thanks for sharing your thoughts with me)
